id: title:dmarchuk:add origin product to workflow usage events

review.posthog_relevance: Adds optional origin_product field and test to workflow action reports, potentially supporting downstream attribution or lineage tracking.
review.reason: The supplied hunk P1.F2.H1 demonstrates a localized, bounded change: adding an optional field and a corresponding test. This aligns with Tier 1, which covers narrow, localised maintenance or small behaviour corrections. No broader systemic capability or critical path improvement is demonstrated. The tier and explanation are consistent.
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit of preserving origin context and the downstream systems relying on it are not demonstrated in the supplied hunk; this is a potential benefit, not an observed outcome.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds an optional origin_product field to workflow action reports and adds a test asserting its preservation.
observations.posthog_connection: Preserves workflow origin context in HogQL-compatible workflow action reports, potentially supporting downstream attribution or lineage tracking.
